After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

sources_quoted.where: docs/math-foundations.md section 2.3 item 2 (Black Cleaver average stacks)
sources_quoted.quote: Black Cleaver average stacks (ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction): the established model uses a fixed 0.8*max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch). Under the engine's own ordering convention (4 leading ability hits apply stacks before the auto stream) the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C - C(C-1)/(2h) for h >= C; the constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos and deviates by up to +/-20% at the extremes.
reduce_resistance(R, r_flat, r_pct): R <- R - r_flat; R <- R*(1 - r_pct/100)  [flat first, then %]

Support starter upgrades ... : Bloodsong, Celestial Opposition, Dream Maker, Solstice Sleigh, Zaz'Zak's Realmspike (support/ward-starter items ...). ... 1. Bloodsong (support starter upgrade - spellblade proc on support items)

step_1_identify_the_0.3.reasoning: Exhaustive scan of all 324 cached items in data/items.json for effect text matching /armor reduction|reduc.*armor/i returns exactly two items: Black Cleaver ('Each stack inflicts 6% armor reduction, up to 30% at 5 stacks', S1) and Flesheater ('reduces the target's armor and magic resistance by 3 ... total resistances reduction of 30' - FLAT 30, not percent). data/runes.json contains no armor-reduction rune (only Conditioning-style bonus-armor grants).
step_1_identify_the_0.3.arithmetic: Black Cleaver Carve max = 5 stacks x 6% = 30% = 0.30
step_1_identify_the_0.3.conclusion: The old leaf value 0.3 is uniquely Black Cleaver's MAX Carve reduction. It is the only percent-armor-reduction constant in the cache.

step_2_can_the_support_source_it.reasoning: The scenario roster pairs Black Cleaver (shop tags FIGHTER/ONHIT_EFFECTS/ARMOR_PEN/MOVEMENT - not a support item, S4) with Bloodsong (shop tags [SUPPORT], World Atlas starter-upgrade line, S4/S7). The leaf lives under support_events, i.e. the support participant / support-item effect layer. Bloodsong's complete cached effect text (S2 + S3) is: (a) Spellblade - 100% base AD bonus physical damage on-hit; (b) Expose Weakness - target takes 8%-to-5% increased damage from all sources; (c) a stealth-ward active. None of these is a resistance-shred effect. Expose Weakness is a damage AMPLIFIER applied to the outgoing damage, mathematically distinct from armor reduction, which enters via reduce_resistance / m(R) = 100/(100+R) (S6): an 8% amp multiplies post-mitigation damage by 1.08 regardless of R, whereas an armor reduction changes R itself. Further, no SUPPORT-tagged item in the entire cache (48 items: World Atlas, Runic Compass, Bounty of Worlds, Celestial Opposition, Dream Maker, Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, Solstice Sleigh, Bloodsong, Knight's Vow, Zeke's Convergence, ...) mentions 'armor' in its effect text at all.
step_2_can_the_support_source_it.arithmetic: armor_reduction_percent contributed by the support's kit = 0.00 (no shred term exists) -> the field has no value to carry -> absent
step_2_can_the_support_source_it.conclusion: For an event sourced from a Bloodsong-carrying support, the correct armor_reduction_percent is no field / zero contribution.

step_3_reject_the_alternative_reading.reasoning: The only reading under which a support event could legitimately carry a Black Cleaver number is 'field records the target's current shred state, shared across the roster'. Even under that reading 0.3 is not a defensible number, because 0.30 is the FULL 5-stack value and the engine's documented Black Cleaver model never sits at full stacks (S5).
arithmetic: engine constant model: 0.8 x max_stacks = 0.8 x 5 = 4.0 stacks; 4.0 x 6% = 0.24
exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp: stacks(h) = C - C(C-1)/(2h) = 5 - 10/h; reduction(h) = 0.06 x (5 - 10/h) = 0.30 - 0.60/h
h = 5 -> 0.18 ; h = 10 -> 0.24 ; h = 20 -> 0.27 ; h = 100 -> 0.294 ; limit h -> infinity -> 0.30 (never attained for finite h)
step_3_reject_the_alternative_reading.conclusion: 0.30 is attainable only as an unreachable limit; the documented model value would be 0.24 (h~10). So 0.3 is wrong under the shred-state reading too, and correct-by-attribution under the source reading is <absent>. Both readings reject 0.3; the source reading (the one the field's placement under support_events implies) gives exactly <absent>.

independent_computation.result: <absent> (no armor_reduction_percent on a Bloodsong-sourced support event)

caveats: The golden baseline file and the engine source were deliberately not read (runbook R-18/R-19 isolation), so the exact field semantics of support_events[].armor_reduction_percent were inferred from the leaf path plus the cached item data. Step 3 shows the verdict is unchanged under the competing semantic reading: 0.3 is wrong either way.

If some future roster gave the SUPPORT participant Black Cleaver itself, a shred field on its events would be legitimate - but then the sourced value would be the engine's averaged 0.24 (or the hits/2 short-fight branch), not 0.30.
